items.title: Harold E. Peterson Interview, 1979-08-06
items.q: the last time that I remember that they had a band was when Emile Stein had died

ctx.x: And you played for funerals too, you said?

Oh yeah, I played for funerals when I was real young over in Gretna. You see, years ago, the Musicians Union, now this wasn't for no musician, this one, or these D's that I played, but the musicians used to furnish a ten piece band when a member died, and the band used to play at the church. And the last time that I remember that they had a band was when Emile Stein had died, and it seemed like to me, Emile must have been living on Arch Street or something, it was a church down around, somewhere around in this…
Well, in Gretna now, who would that be for?
